# DataGridLoadingIndicator

`Flare.Components.DataGridLoadingIndicator`

How a FlareDataGrid shows its loading state.

## Values

| Name | Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Spinner` | `0` | A centered circular progress ring overlaid on the (dimmed) table. |
| `Skeleton` | `1` | Shimmering skeleton placeholder rows in place of the data. |
| `Text` | `2` | A small text label only (no animation). |
| `ProgressLine` | `3` | A thin indeterminate progress line at the top edge of the table; rows stay visible and interactive. |

## Used by components

- `FlareDataGrid`
